verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes an OpenAPI spec titled 'Gateway REST API' at version 5.10.0, with /v1-prefixed endpoints. That indicates a versioned API surface. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or change-notice commitments, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, an explicit API versioning and compatibility guarantee, a changelog or migration notices, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Published OpenAPI document ("openapi: 3.1.0", info.title "Gateway REST API", version 5.10.0) covering /v1/accounts, deployment, model and training endpoints
